name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks, Sacchin! To think you actually remembered my birthday... I'm touched.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Speaking of which, Nana-chan, I bet you forgot my birthday~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Spot on~ That's way too amazing~ Even I almost forgot it~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So anyway~, for my birthday, I want Sans Souci's special deluxe birthday cake~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't shamelessly demand your own birthday present on someone else's birthday!」
